posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked: The update did give away an exciting villian. It is the mysterious Questioniare. His real name was Mark, he was raised to question everything to learn all the answers to everything. When finally he asked the wrong question to a evil gypsy, who than put a curse on him that turned him into a living question mark. His villian cards actually fill in the blanks from his missing character card, thus allowing him to adapt to any situation. His Health cards even scale with one another giving him a max health of 500! Not to mention nearly each of his villian cards are indestructable, making things even more difficult as the battle rages on.
